full_judgment:
Kazi A.T. Monowaruddin, J: This Rule, at the instance of the defendant, arises out of the judgment and decree dated 8-11-93 passed by the Subordinate Judge and Artha Rin Adalat, Barisal, in Title Appeal No. 195 of 1992 reversing those dated 30-8-92 of the Assistant Judge, 2nd Additional Court, Barisal, in title suit No. 213 of 1992 (previously title suit No. 1344 of 1984) dismissing the suit ex parte. 

 5. The plaintiff examined 5 witnesses and the defendant examined 3 witnesses. The learned trial Court on consideration of evidence both documentary and oral dismissed the suit by judgment and decree dated 27-5-87. 

 6. Being aggrieved by the aforesaid judgment and decree the plaintiff preferred title Appeal No. 101 of 1987 before the learned District Judge, Barisal which was ultimately heard by the learned Additional District Judge, Barisal who by his judgment and decree dated 25-5-91 allowed the appeal and sent the suit back on remand for fresh trial in the light of the observations given therein. 

 8. There is a note appearing on the left hand margin of the order that "আদালতের নির্দেশ থাকা সত্তে¦ও বিবাদী পক্ষের কৌশলীগুলোকে ঘাচনা করা সত্বেও seen করেন নাই" Subsequently thereto defendants never appeared and the judgment was passed ex parte on 30-8-92 dismissing the suit. Against that the plaintiff-opposite parties filed title Appeal No.195 of 1992 and the learned appellate Court after hearing the parties and perusing the records allowed the appeal reversed the judgment and decree passed by the trial Court and decreed the suit. 

 9. Being aggrieved by the aforesaid judgment and decree dated 8-11-93 the defendant petitioner moved the petition in revision and obtained the present Rule. 

 18. In the result, the Rule is made absolute, the impugned Judgments and decrees are set aside and the case is sent back on remand to the trial Court with a direction to dispose of the suit in the light of the observations given in the judgment dated 25-5-91 in Trial Appeal No. 101 of 1987 and in accordance with law, within 4 (four) months from the receipt of the records.
